sources.title: low-light-image-restoration/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: The task is to jointly denoise and perform 4× super-resolution on 312×312 low-light RGB images, reconstructing clean 1250×1250 high-resolution outputs — a single model solving two problems at once. Evaluation Metric: RMSE on 100 linearly-sampled grayscale pixels per image (lower = better).
